evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 涵虚朗鉴、福海
evidence.excerpt_zh: 涵虛朗鑑在福海東即雷峯夕照正宇其北稍西為惠如春又東北為尋雲榭又北為貽蘭庭為會心不逺其南為臨衆芳為雲錦墅為菊秀松㽔為萬景天全（明圓園册）臣等謹按涵虛朗鑑四十景之一額為皇上御書舊懸湖西澄虛榭後移置湖東雷峯夕照軒宇内惠如春尋雲榭諸額亦御書
evidence.summary: East of 福海: 涵虛朗鑑, the main range of 雷峯夕照, with 惠如春, 尋雲榭, 貽蘭庭, 會心不逺, 臨衆芳, 雲錦墅, 菊秀松㽔 and 萬景天全. The plaque first hung at 澄虛榭 on the west shore and was moved here, which explains why the 1744 preface places the scene on the west.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
